title: Requirement to evidence matrix for re-slice 0005
readingRule: A gate is green only where its own instrument reports zero failures and a zero exit code.

dotnet build ViciOne.ServiceBus.sln -c Release, exit 0, 0 errors, four target frameworks
gates.windows: NOT_EXECUTED locally; the matrix stays visible in the required profile and is not reported as passed

gates.detail: Two consecutive full runs after re-slice 0005, 1837 of 1837 each.
Unfiltered. All five cases from record 0027 now execute and pass. Twenty cases are not executed and every one of them is named in the inventory; zero unclassified.

gates.result: 33 assemblies, 27473 members at the baseline and 27488 now, 15 additions, zero removals, zero changes on the messaging surface. None of the four production corrections moved the public surface.
187 findings, 44 high or critical, zero transitive without a resolved dependency path

productionCorrections.what: A cancellation raised on the linked backoff token is decided from the sources, not from the exception.
The wait for the on-demand bus endpoint is bounded and reports instead of blocking forever.
BusStarted clears the stopping flag that Stop sets, so a restarted job service accepts work again.
The AMQP close reason is trimmed to what the protocol carries and a failed close no longer replaces the real failure.

productOwnerAuthorised.authorised: Product owner, 2026-08-10, to be reported to the lead architect
productOwnerAuthorised.whatChanged: The assertion moved to the point where the conflict can arise, the materialisation of the bus endpoint, because on-demand materialisation is deliberate and Start() cannot meet the conflict. The asserted type is exact, not relaxed to a base type.
productOwnerAuthorised.whatDidNotChange: The on-demand behaviour itself, and the fact that a conflict must be reported.

productOwnerAuthorised.authorised: Product owner, 2026-08-10, to be reported to the lead architect
productOwnerAuthorised.whatChanged: The spec runs in its own virtual host, created but not cleaned, so the hosted service restart it performs cannot wipe the sagas mid-scenario and cannot disturb its siblings.
productOwnerAuthorised.authorisationNotUsed: A budget increase was also authorised and is not used. It was tried at thirty and sixty seconds and did not help, because the cause was the mid-scenario clean up, not the budget. The original ten seconds are restored.

notWeakened: No assertion was relaxed; one was strengthened and one moved under product owner authorisation.
No timeout was extended in the delivered state.
No filter was introduced in the required path.
No [Ignore] was added; five [Explicit] were removed so the cases run.
No case was reclassified as not due; the open list is empty because every case was fixed.
Directory.Packages.props is untouched; RabbitMQ.Client stays at 7.2.1.
notCleared: MessagePack 3.1.6 / GHSA-hv8m-jj95-wg3x in ViciOne.ServiceBus.MessagePack remains a mandatory follow-up order.
